page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal text, only small reference-like marks in the margin.

main_text.p: nachus[?] erat, Ecclesiam ac religionem Dei, præ cae-teris omnibus oneravit, vir alioqui doctus & bonus. Parentum domos in monasteria vertit, & primum eorum Andreæ Apostolo dedicavit. Scholas cantorum instituit, & Ambrosii more Ecclesiasticas cantiones, quas Græce dicimus Antiphonas, composuit. Officiarium Ecclesiæ fecit, antiphonarium nocturnum & diurnum disposuit, sacrorum normas digesit, missarum ritus complanavit, & eius canonem consarcinavit. Introitus missarum cum Psalmorum particulis cantari fecit, nonies Kyrieleyson recitari iussit, Alleluia per totum annum extra quadragesimam vociferari post Gradale curavit, & pro tempore Paschali offertoriis & post communibus idemq; Alleluia adiunxit. Tres postulationes canoni missali adiecit, scilicet: Dies-q; nostros in tua pace, & cæt. orationem Dominicam super Eucharistiæ panem in altum dici aut cani præcepit, super Apostolorum mortua cadavera missas celebrari mandavit, et Deus in adiutorium, cum Gloria patri, horis canonicis addidit. Letanias & processiones excogitavit, atq; in septem ordines, scilicet, clericorum, Monachorum, Monialium, puerorum, Laicorum, viduarum, ac mulierum coniugatarum, distribuit. page.notes: Small marks in the margin (c-like signs and asterisks beside lines) are reference or printer's marks without printed text; not transcribed. Opening word "nachus" is a fragment and partly unclear. Line-end "Dies-q;" is printed as "Diesq;" with a q-abbreviation; the hyphen marks a line break. The final word "pistæ" is printed at lower right and is treated as the catchword. The lower-left mark is a stain. The page number "45" at top right is read with some uncertainty.
